definitions.explanation: the management of incoming and outgoing money to ensure a business has sufficient funds for operations

notes:
{資金繰|しきんぐ}り is a crucial business term referring to managing the flow of money in and out of a company to maintain operations.

WRITING:
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧ (funds, capital)
- {繰|く}り (⟦{繰|く}る→繰る：30725_kuru⟧ = to reel, manage, operate)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧ (cash flow is tight)
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧ (cash flow is tough)
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧ (cash flow deteriorates)
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧ (cash flow improves)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (cash flow statement)
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧ (to have trouble with cash flow)
- {資金繰|しきんぐ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to manage cash flow)

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
- Critical for small and medium enterprises
- A major cause of business failure when mismanaged
- Often discussed in relation to payment terms, receivables, and payables
